scope.candidate_set: TGIFS primary preparation in the archived step scan, all three routes
scope.accuracy: Unchanged empirical acceptance at each circuit's outer-step readouts
scope.timing: Serial, per-call overhead plus absolute generator coefficient times inverse rate
scope.normalization: X=sqrt(omega_b)*phi, P=Pi/sqrt(omega_b), G coefficients have no implicit 1/2
scope.assumptions: Native drift is controlled during ideal pulses; rates are sensitivity parameters
scope.implementation_error: Assumed allowance, no duration-dependent noise or pulse simulation
scope.rate_slices: CD and qubit inverse rates equal tau_A, Gaussian rates varied in tau_A units
scope.overhead_slices: Common per-primitive overhead u_0*tau_A, native pair overhead separate
scope.sign_and_phase: Equal rates for both signs, Rz charged as a physical rotation in displayed slices
scope.empty_pool: Selection stops with an explicit error when any route has no accepted candidate
scope.optimality: Minimum over the evaluated step-scan candidates only
